door:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent low-resolution pixel-art game sprite, a CLOSED HORIZONTAL DOUBLE SLIDING SECURITY DOOR for an existing cold, oppressive underground hospital.
Reference image 1 and image 2 are STYLE AND PIXEL SCALE REFERENCES ONLY: the existing native 640x224 hospital floor backgrounds; do not redraw or include these backgrounds. Reference image 3 is the approved tiny player, only for consistent coarse pixels and scale.
Subject: a squat, wide, wall-embedded industrial double sliding steel security door seen from a very slight top-down game camera, the same presentation as the short horizontal north walls in the reference. Closed two equal panels separated by a vertical center seam. Cool charcoal blue-gray metal panels, one-pixel raised steel border, a little wear, two tiny ventilation grooves, and a single tiny muted red indicator. A compact keypad block on the right jamb but NO readable text or numbers. The door is a wide low horizontal barrier, not a tall freestanding human-proportioned door.
Native resolution EXACTLY 32x16 pixels, aspect ratio 2:1. Coarse pixel art with a strict, economical 12-color palette, sharply defined square clusters, no antialiasing, no gradients, no noisy subpixel details, no soft light. You may supply a uniform integer enlargement of this native 32x16 art. The door fills almost the whole rectangular canvas, and its opening can later be animated by separating the left and right halves horizontally.
Color values approximate darkest #08141d, deep #112532, steel #254452, midtone #3c606c, sparse cyan edge #57919c, tiny dull red #914746. Match the desaturated cold hospital reference; do not add saturated neon lighting.
TRUE transparent background. One door only. No wall/floor scene, no people, no weapons, no open state, no text, no digits, no logo, no watermark, no shadow outside the asset.

Input images are style references ONLY, the existing hospital floor background and approved new cold steel door. Preserve their desaturated blue-gray palette and very coarse square pixel clusters, but generate only the cabinet animation sheet.

Clean square hard pixels, no smooth shading or antialiasing, no complex wires, no tiny typography. Uniform integer enlargement allowed but maintain this low native art resolution.
